title: Honor note disclosure when capturing and exporting native evidence
outcome: Honor note disclosure when capturing and exporting native evidence
acceptance: Native evidence capture and final export enforce the selected binding's note and activity disclosure profile, so a notes-off binding cannot publish note bodies or restricted note/activity content through its evidence closure.

Complete canonical IDs, original bytes and feed-witness closure invariants are preserved: a disallowed closure is explicitly refused rather than silently dropping required records, rewriting originals or granting imported authority; any separate evidence-disclosure selection is explicit and consistently enforced.

Behavior tests capture a real run with work-scoped memory notes and evidence summaries under notes-off and disallowed labels, prove no forbidden bodies reach export packs/data commits, and cover permitted disclosed evidence plus replay/profile consistency.

completion.summary: Native evidence capture, replay and each export page enforce the selected binding's immutable note/activity disclosure profile, refusing disallowed full closures before packs are retained while preserving original IDs/bytes.
